title: The Duel Within the Mental Sea
next_chapter_hook: As Chen Ji pierced through layers of illusion to glimpse the true form of that ancient will, his Tianji Record suddenly emitted an unprecedented violent resonance—and that voice told him that this was not merely an old enemy, but his blood relative.

text.content: The void rift suddenly closed before Chen Ji's eyes, and Chen Tianming's whisper thundered through the Mental Sea—"The seventh page will be your final trump card." This was not a warning, but a prophecy, an already carved-into-destiny-law fact.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, but what reflected in his pupils was not the night sky of the Tianqing Sect, but a vast boundless sea of consciousness. His divine sense was forcibly dragged into some higher dimension, where there was no division between heaven and earth, only pure will surging.

dialogue.content: A voice rang out from all directions simultaneously, ancient as the first echo of the universe's birth: "Chen Ji, you've finally come. I've been waiting for you for so long, so long that this Mental Sea has dried up seven cycles."

text.content: Chen Ji looked around, and in the endless void, a massive eye was slowly opening. Within that pupil's depths, stars cycled between destruction and creation, as if the entire universe were merely one of its thoughts.

dialogue.content: A faint smile curled at Chen Ji's lips, that grin cold enough to freeze the void: "Waiting for me? More like waiting for me to set up the chess game so you could harvest, right? Eye of Heavenly Secrets—no, what should I call you? The Ultimate Chess Player? Destiny itself?"

text.content: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' pupil slightly contracted, and countless stars trembled in response. It did not rage, but instead emitted a low laugh, that sound like the simultaneous collapse of millions of epochs: "You're far more interesting than I anticipated, successor of Chen Xuan."

dialogue.content: "But interesting doesn't mean you can change anything." That voice suddenly became incomparably majestic, as if Heavenly Dao Law itself were speaking, "The Tianji Record is a piece I set in motion. You are merely a piece within the pieces. Eight hundred years of布局, today I collect the net."

text.content: Before the words finished, countless threads of karma shot out from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' pupil, those lines tangling toward Chen Ji's divine sense, each one connected to his past memories—every time he used the Tianji Record to foresee the future, he was reporting to this eye.

Yet Chen Ji did not struggle, instead proactively rushing forward. His divine sense transformed into a stream of light, directly charging into those karma threads. "Report? Then let me ask—what do you see?" he coldly asked.

At this moment, the five pages of the Tianji Record Fragment simultaneously bloomed within Chen Ji's Mental Sea. The first page's heavenly secrets deduction, the second page's fate threads, the third page's karma lock, the fourth page's time reversal, and the fifth page's... that was a blank.

dialogue.content: "The fifth page?" The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice cracked for the first time, within that will woven from countless karma, a tiny fissure opened, "Impossible... Chen Xuan clearly sealed it! How could you open it!"

text.content: Chen Ji's smile grew deeper. "Chen Tianming told me the seventh page is my final trump card. But he didn't say—the fifth page is YOUR fatal weakness." His voice was cold as frost, each word unshakeable as Heavenly Dao Law itself.

choice.prompt: The true form of the fifth page has revealed itself, Chen Ji is about to launch the decisive attack—

choices.visible_reward: Uncover the Truth of the Fifth Page: Free Will

text.content: Without hesitation, Chen Ji poured his divine sense into the fifth page. In an instant, that blank transformed into countless stars across the sky, each star an endpoint of possibility—and all endpoints were converging toward the Eye of Heavenly Secrets at this moment.

text.content: On the surface, Chen Ji pushed all the fifth page's power outward, but actually contracted the core power into a tiny seed, hidden at the deepest part of the fate torrent. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' karma threads greedily lunged for it—it took the bait.

choices.text: Summon the Wills of the Tianji Record's Past Inheritance Holders
choices.description: Abandon solitary resistance, attempt to awaken the consciousness of past inheritance holders sleeping within the Tianji Record, jointly confront the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.
choices.visible_cost: Must Pay Part of Divine Sense as the Awakening Cost

text.content: Chen Ji's divine sense suddenly sank deep, diving into the core depths of the Tianji Record. There slumbered the remnant souls of past prophets—Chen Xuan, Chen Tianming...一个个名字如同丰碑般矗立在虚无之中。此刻，它们正在苏醒.
A name slowly emerged from the blank of the fifth page—that was not the name of any technique or secret art, but a concept, a concept that even the Eye of Heavenly Secrets feared: "Choice."

dialogue.content: "No—!" The Eye of Heavenly Secrets emitted a void-shredding roar, those karma threads frantically contracting, attempting to completely erase Chen Ji before "Choice" took shape, "You cannot possess this! Destiny should have no branching paths!"

text.content: Chen Ji felt that world-annihilating will bearing down on him, his divine sense nearly crushed to pieces. But the corner of his lips反而勾起一抹嘲讽的弧度—the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was afraid, which meant he bet correctly.

dialogue.content: "Scared?" Chen Ji's voice echoed through the Mental Sea, clear and merciless, "The great Heavenly Dao Will, also afraid of a mortal possessing the right to choose? It seems you're more like a bird trapped in a cage than me."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' fear was fully exposed, but its counterattack was also about to arrive—

choices.text: Pursue While Afraid, Completely Rout the Heavenly Dao Will
choices.description: At the enemy's weakest moment, strike with full force, use the power of "Choice" to completely shatter the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' karma laws.

choices.visible_reward: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets Temporarily Retreats, Gains Breathing Room
choices.risk_hint: May Trigger the Heavenly Dao Will's Ultimate Counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate for a moment, condensing the power of "Choice" into an invisible sword, stabbing directly toward the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' core. In that instant, that eye spanning the universe violently contracted, as if burned by something.

choices.text: Retreat to Advance, Seek Truth Within the Cracks
choices.description: No longer pursue defeating the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, but use its revealed flaws to deeply peer into the truth behind it—why does it exist? And why does it so fear free will?
choices.visible_cost: May See Truth That Should Not Be Known
choices.visible_reward: Discover the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' Origin Secret
choices.risk_hint: The Truth May Be Far More Terrifying Than Imagined

text.content: Chen Ji did not pursue, but instead transformed the power of "Choice" into a mirror, aimed at the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' deepest crack. Within it, he saw—a seal, countless shackles, and an ancient existence imprisoned for不知道多少纪元.

The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' roar gradually calmed, that eye spanning the void was refocusing. It did not recede, but instead became even more intense—that was the gaze unique to a hunter reassessing its prey's value.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji..." The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice became low and dangerous, "You made me see something I shouldn't have seen. Since that's the case, let me show you what true despair looks like."

text.content: The words finished, countless images surged into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—those were the futures of those he cherished most: Su Qingyao calling his name in a pool of blood, Ye Qing's despair when sacrificed by the Holy Sect, Chen Nian's weeping imprisoned in eternal darkness...

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's divine sense trembled violently, those images too real, each frame like witnessing with his own eyes. But he quickly gritted his teeth, coldly saying: "Threatening me with the people I love? Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you're no different from those ordinary mortals."

choice.prompt: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets has played its final trump card—the tragic fates of Chen Ji's beloved ones—this is naked psychological warfare—

text.content: Chen Ji spread open his arms, using his divine sense as a net, accepting all those tragic illusions deep into his Mental Sea. Su Qingyao's blood, Ye Qing's despair, Chen Nian's tears—each drop of pain carved like a knife on his soul, but he endured it all without a sound.

text.content: Chen Ji coldly smiled, injecting the power of "Choice" into those fate illusions. Those images not only did not dissipate, but began to reverse—reversing toward the direction of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. Soon, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets would see its own future.

text.content: Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, echoing like thunder in the Mental Sea: "Since you can see my destiny, what about your own destiny? What makes you so afraid of free will—could it be that you yourself also have no choice?"

The confrontation in the Mental Sea fell into eerie silence. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' massive pupil spanning the universe trembled slightly, as if Chen Ji's words had struck some隐秘的神经. After a moment, a low laugh came from all directions.

dialogue.content: "Clever." The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice carried an indefinable nuance, "Indeed a worthy successor chosen by Chen Xuan, with some real insight. But do you think knowing this will change anything?"

text.content: That pupil suddenly contracted, and the stars in the Mental Sea began moving in eerie trajectories. Chen Ji felt a pressure incomparably more terrifying than before taking shape—that was Heavenly Dao Law itself responding to its summons.

dialogue.content: "I've given you too many chances, Chen Ji." The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice completely cooled, "Now, the game is over. Let me tell you what it means—Heavenly Fate Cannot Be Defied."

text.content: At this critical moment, an ancient sigh rang out from the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea. It was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, awakened by this world-shaking confrontation, using its final strand of strength to issue a warning: "Master, the seventh page... is Chen Nian. She is the true seventh page of the Tianji Record—Heavenly Fate Lock Key."

Chen Ji's pupils violently contracted. Chen Nian—the sister he'd lost for years, that existence that blurred all prophecies—she wasn't a victim taken by the Holy Sect, but... the final missing piece of the Tianji Record itself?

dialogue.content: A wave of fury rose from Chen Ji's heart, colliding with his reason. But he quickly suppressed this emotion, coldly saying: "Holy Sect... So from the very beginning, you've been using her against me."

text.content: A flash of triumph crossed the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' pupil. "Now that you know, what difference does it make? Chen Nian is currently at the deepest part of the Holy Sect, serving as the final chain sealing me. As long as she exists, I can never fully descend—and you can never gather the complete Tianji Record."

dialogue.content: "This is the Deadly Ground I set for you, Chen Ji." The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' voice brimmed with cruel satisfaction, "If you want to save your sister, you must break the seal and let me fully descend; if you want to stop me, you must sacrifice your sister. Such is Heavenly Fate—how will you choose?"

text.content: The stars in the Mental Sea stopped moving, the entire world seemingly waiting for Chen Ji's answer. Yet at this moment, a meaningful smile actually appeared on Chen Ji's face—that was the smile a chess player wears when seeing the opponent's cards.

dialogue.content: "Deadly Ground?" Chen Ji lightly laughed, that laughter echoing through the Mental Sea, carrying an inexplicable calm, "Eye of Heavenly Secrets, you've forgotten one thing—I was never playing chess alone. And you are not the only chess player on the board."

text.content: The moment the words fell, a crack suddenly opened at the edge of the Mental Sea. Through that crack, Chen Ji saw another dimension—where stood a blurry figure, surrounded by law forces utterly different from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

That figure turned its head, and their eyes met. Though the face was shrouded in mist, that familiarity in those eyes made Chen Ji's heart tremble—those were Chen Nian's eyes, the sister he'd searched for through countless years.

At this moment, the Eye of Heavenly Secrets emitted a thunderous roar of rage: "Chen Nian! How dare you—!" That massive pupil frantically contracted, countless karma threads shooting toward Chen Nian's figure, all bounced back by an invisible barrier.

dialogue.content: An ethereal voice rang out in the Mental Sea, carrying a hint of apology: "Brother, I'm sorry for making you search so long. But the Holy Sect thought I was the seal, when in reality—I am the key that locks away what they truly want to release."

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Chen Nian's words exploded in his mind like thunder—she wasn't sealing the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, but sealing another existence far more terrifying? The Holy Sect's true purpose, from beginning to end, was never the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?

The Mental Sea began violently trembling, both the Eye of Heavenly Secrets and Chen Nian's figures becoming blurred simultaneously. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul emitted its final sigh: "Master, time is up. The confrontation in the Mental Sea temporarily ends, but the real chess game... has only just begun."

Chen Ji felt an irresistible force pushing him out of the Mental Sea. In the final moment before consciousness returned to his body, he saw deep within the Eye of Heavenly Secrets' pupil, a terrifying existence sealed for不知道多少纪元 slowly opening its eyes—those were eyes identical to Chen Nian's.

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he had returned to the secret chamber of the Tianqing Sect. Cold sweat drenched his body, but his gaze was clearer than ever before. The confrontation in the Mental Sea had revealed too many truths, and the one that alarmed him most was—the connection between Chen Nian and that ancient existence was far deeper than he'd imagined.

Chen Ji slowly stood up and pushed open the chamber door. The starlight in the night sky was dim, as if the entire world was mourning for the approaching storm. He gazed toward the direction of the Holy Sect and softly said: "Sister, wait for me. This time, it's my turn to save you."
